body:
astra-syncdec1: #2393 head `d006b4dc9decd4ae6b613fdb12cf8ad5fec8cf1f` has completed local validation of both Opus review corrections: core D648 matrix **1 test / 4 cases passed**; OpenAI-menu + shared-provider held-Enter **2 tests passed**. Prior head `67f5a07` passed **103 TUI + 6 app-server** on both macOS and glitch; production code is identical at the new head (only the two test files changed). Rust1.99.1; exactly 2 glitch compilations used, no third. Exact-head Opus round 2 is running; all checks must complete before merge.

Review ledger clarification: the retained-service-tier `None` expectation is a sync-base adaptation, not caused by D636 provider forwarding. Opus round 1 also noted a low, nonblocking follow-up: the queued-agent-message wrapper can combine “messages remain queued” with the detached-child refusal's “This message was not kept”, and idle wake-up may emit the refusal instead of `NotSubmitted`. Denial remains intact; this follow-up is left here without expanding the owner-decision patch. The blocking core expectation and missing OpenAI menu coverage were fixed, not deferred.
